reason: The hypothesis directly restates the findings of P7, P13, and P15, which already report that adding 0.5 at.% W to an AlCoCrFeNi HEA coating improves high-temperature wear resistance through lattice distortion and W-rich intermetallic compounds. The proposed mechanism of a protective oxide glaze layer is also a well-known concept in high-temperature tribology (P19, P23). The only change is applying the same intervention to a CoCrFeNi matrix instead of AlCoCrFeNi, without any justification for why the effect would transfer or how the absence of Al would alter the outcome.

provenance.mechanism: P7, P13, P15, P19, P23, general knowledge

W induces lattice distortion and W-rich intermetallic compounds
improved high-temperature wear resistance and reduced friction coefficient
